entities.text: Milon Mondal @ Asad Ali Seikh @ Asad Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
1 . 
Petitioner is the brother-in-law of the victim-housewife.
2. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that there are contradictory dying declarations.
On such score, co-accused viz. mother-in-law has been enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits victim implicates the petitioner in the dying declarations.
4. We have considered the materials on record including the two dying declarations.
Petitioner has been consistently named in both the dying declarations.
He does not stand on the same footing with co- accused whose name was incorporated in the subsequent dying declaration which appears to be an embellished one.
Under such circumstances, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
5. The application for bail is thus rejected.
